old.text: Its magnetic field helps shield life from solar storms.

current.text: A magnetic field is an invisible part of space where magnetic forces can act. Earth’s field reaches into space and makes a region called the magnetosphere. It turns many particles from the Sun away from Earth.

old.text: Its moon Titan has lakes and rain made from methane.

current.text: Methane is usually a gas on Earth. Titan is so cold that liquid methane can fall as rain and fill lakes.
